fields.label: Maximum months of living costs required for Student visa
fields.notes: A part of a month is rounded up to the next full month (Immigration Rules, Appendix Student, ST 12.3).

fields.label: Consecutive days funds must be held in bank account
fields.notes: Funds must be held for a 28-day period (Appendix Student, ST 12.6). The gov.uk page says the end date of that period must be within 31 days of the application date.

fields.label: Maximum days between end of 28-day hold and visa application
fields.notes: Read from the gov.uk Student visa money page, 28 November 2026.

HC 584 (3 September 2026), APP ST8 to ST10: from 30 November 2026 the monthly amount in ST 12 changes from £1529 to £1570 for applications made on or after that date. Approve on or after 30 November 2026.
